note: application menu bar -- renders the fixed operator vocabulary of File, Edit, Selection, View, Go, Run, Terminal and Help
activity bar navigation -- renders the fixed operator vocabulary of Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run and Extensions
operator toolbars -- render fixed commands such as Accounts, Settings, Refresh, Clear Results, New Search Editor, Split and More
Search view title and controls -- renders the fixed Search heading and fixed search-view commands
search widget command buttons -- render the fixed Toggle Replace and search-details commands
search option controls -- render the fixed Case Sensitive, Whole Word and Regular Expression vocabulary
search query-details control -- renders the fixed operator command for search details

Getting Started interface -- renders fixed operator-authored headings, introductory copy, New File, Open File, Open Folder, Source Control, Remote, learning categories, progress controls and startup settings; the recent-files region is excluded
Getting Started editor tab label -- renders the fixed operator vocabulary of the Getting Started page
screen-reader mode status control -- renders the fixed accessibility-mode command vocabulary
